svg.title: Sodapop synthetic order-total request
svg.desc: A synthetic maintenance exercise: correct quantities in an order preview. Acceptance totals are 375 cents for three units at 125 cents, 1000 cents for two at 125 plus three at 250, and zero for empty carts or zero quantity. Deliver regression tests, observed checks, and a human-reviewed diff. This is not a live result.

g.text: Our order preview ignores item quantities.
Explain it. Add regressions. Fix only what matters.
OUTCOME: observed tests + a human-reviewed diff
No tax, discounts, dependencies, automatic commit or push.
Preparation asset only. Not a live AI result or customer endorsement.
